title: Pauli-Y: Bit + Phase Flip
description:
## Pauli-Y: Bit + Phase Flip

Apply the **Pauli-Y gate** to qubit 0, starting from |0⟩.

### Goal
Your circuit should produce the statevector:
```
i|1⟩  →  [0, i]
```

### Background
Interviewers love the Pauli gates because they test whether you track **phase**, not just bit values:
- X flips the bit: X|0⟩ = |1⟩
- Z flips the phase: Z|1⟩ = −|1⟩
- **Y does both**: Y|0⟩ = i|1⟩, Y|1⟩ = −i|0⟩

The factor of i is a global phase here, so measurement still gives |1⟩ with certainty — but in larger circuits that phase stops being global and starts to matter.

### Constraints
- Use exactly **1 qubit**
- Solution must be within fidelity ε=0.01 of the target statevector
hints: One single gate does the whole job.
Y is the only Pauli gate with imaginary entries.
Y = iXZ up to convention — but the composer has a dedicated Y gate.
